description:
All theses one CabalSpy ID user has posted, newest first, with token and the
    position they hold. Use to judge a caller's track record: "What has
    @CabalSpySol been bullish on, and did it work out?".

    Needs your own CabalSpy API key with a CabalSpy ID instance (no demo).

csid_id.description: CabalSpy ID user id (a UUID, the 'sub' of a Login with CabalSpy ID token), e.g. '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000'.
csid_id.title: Csid Id

cursor.description: Pagination cursor taken from the previous response. Leave empty for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

instance.description: Your CabalSpy ID instance (its client_id, e.g. 'csid_1a2b…'). Only needed when your account has several instances. Leave empty otherwise.
instance.title: Instance

limit.description: How many theses to return (1-25, default 10).
limit.title: Limit

username.description: X handle of the author, with or without @, e.g. 'CabalSpySol'. Pass username or csid_id.
username.title: Username

name: csid_user_theses
